name: Marshal Maxwell
summary: At Morgan's Vigil, Marshal Maxwell holds the northern ridge against the Blackrock clan and Dark Iron dwarves. The Stormwind officer directs scouts through the hostile crags and searches for his captured comrade, Marshal Reginald Windsor.

sections.title: A Lonely Post on the Steppes
sections.body:
Marshal Maxwell commands Stormwind's detachment at Morgan's Vigil on the southern rim of the Burning Steppes. The outpost overlooks ash, dragonkin, and Blackrock orcs. Travelers crossing the fiery crags find a rare friendly post here.

From the rocky ridge, Maxwell directs the defense against mountain threats before they can move south into Redridge and Elwynn.

sections.title: Uncovering the Truth in the Mountain
sections.body: Marshal Maxwell directs field operations aimed at Blackrock Spire and Blackrock Depths. Reports suggest his captured comrade, Marshal Reginald Windsor, may still be alive in the Dark Iron dwarves' dungeons. Maxwell gathers intelligence and sends trusted champions to attempt a rescue. From Morgan's Vigil, he links frontier scouting with turmoil inside Stormwind's gates.

faq.answer: Marshal Maxwell is a high-ranking Stormwind officer at Morgan's Vigil in the Burning Steppes. He commands the local Alliance forces watching the Blackrock orcs, Black dragons, and Dark Iron dwarves.

faq.q: Why is Marshal Maxwell stationed at Morgan's Vigil?
aliases: why is maxwell in burning steppes
faq.answer: Morgan's Vigil guards the Alliance's northernmost fortified ridge above the Redridge Mountains. Maxwell holds the mountain pass and watches for threats from Blackrock Mountain.

faq.q: What is Maxwell's connection to Marshal Windsor?
faq.answer: Marshal Maxwell helps lead the search for his captured comrade, Marshal Reginald Windsor, taken to Blackrock Depths. He coordinates rescue efforts and sends vital intelligence about Windsor back to Stormwind.

faq.q: Does Marshal Maxwell help organize strikes against Blackrock Spire?
faq.answer: Yes. Maxwell directs veteran Alliance champions against the Blackrock clan's leaders and the forces holding Blackrock Spire's heights. His directives target General Drakkisath and his forces.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion in the Burning Steppes, you find Stormwind's authority in Marshal Maxwell, who leads the campaign against Blackrock Mountain.
As a warrior, you see Stormwind's frontline discipline in Maxwell. He coordinates deep assaults behind enemy lines amid the volcanic ash.
